🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 13, 2026

Moon, in detriment in Capricorn, holds a square to Saturn, in its fall in Aries. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: what you own is being counted by somebody else’s arithmetic.

Easier — Saying no to a thing you can afford and do not want.
Harder — Treating a passing squeeze as a permanent condition.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 3-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you from Leo, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. From Capricorn, Moon cuts across the appetite. Cardinal fire starts and is invoiced for it. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. Moon in Capricorn sides with you before you have argued. Fixed earth holds, and holding asks nothing back. Venus has been out of Scorpio for four weeks now.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, where nothing is owed to it. From Libra, Venus concedes the point early. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. A week ago Mercury was still held by Sun; that is finished.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, out of place in Capricorn. From Scorpio, Sun agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Cardinal water: beginning costs almost nothing. The opposition of a week ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, holds no rank in Scorpio and simply works. From Libra, Venus hands you an opening. Fire keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Since Sun crossed out of Libra, the question has changed.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon trines you from Capricorn, meeting no resistance. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. Mercury turned back three weeks ago; the review is still running.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. From Capricorn, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal air: the beginning has a price on it. The square to Pluto that held two weeks ago has let go.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. Moon sextiles you from Capricorn: help that waits to be asked for. Water keeps what it has, cheaply. Four weeks, 14° of Mars: slight, and real.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Venus sextiles you from Libra: a door left ajar. Fire adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. It has stood four weeks; by now the cost is known.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon crosses your sign: nothing you hold is seen from a distance. Earth begins and is billed in the same gesture. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Venus trines you from Libra, and what you hold finds words unforced. Air that holds on, holding without strain. Seven days ago none of this was in place.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Moon in Capricorn opens a gap you have to step into. Mutable water: two answers, neither expensive. The hold Mercury had two weeks ago is not there any more.
